body:
Lorazepam is a hell of a drug. I'm on  two other mood balancing drugs, but this is the one I can feel working right away. Intrusive thoughts are not a thing right now, worries about tomorrow are gone, and if I want to take a nap it's fine - I get good sleep and don't wake early to terrors and fears. Even stopped having PTSD nightmares.
Recreationally mixes well with cannabis (even those high TCH strains that can cause paranoia) and adds to a nice relaxed mellow and euphoric high so recreationally it's awesome.
This is not a performance drug, I get couch lock and slower cognitive abilities.
But for a lazy afternoon with a joint, it's a soma holiday.
For legit anxiety and panic disorder, it's a godsend.
Much luck, all.
